sanity.known_free_issue: freejoint fork_stl pressed on the palm, neck or handle can rock (touch force swings up to ~0.5-3 N, slide_z by ~5-30 um; the handle at >= 5 N may not settle). Cause: each tine tip rests on the table along a level edge and MuJoCo's plane-mesh collision reports one vertex per convex part, so the support point flips between the edge's two corners. Contact margins or explicit table/part pairs steady it but shift the gel's force-depth law by 20-250 um, so they are not used. The default (static) fork and freejoint presses on the tines are not affected.
